description: This file defines the Coocook::DeploymentHandler package, which extends DBIx::Class::DeploymentHandler to customize database deployment and upgrade procedures, particularly for SQLite databases. It includes methods for initializing deployment scripts, upgrading schemas, and a workaround for index name mangling.

classes.name: Coocook::DeploymentHandler
classes.description: A Perl package extending DBIx::Class::DeploymentHandler to customize deployment and upgrade behavior for the Coocook project, with specific handling for SQLite databases and index name mangling.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the deployment handler, checks the script directory, converts it to an absolute path, and calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs schema upgrade, with special handling for SQLite databases to disable foreign key checks during upgrade.
